description: Same 50 fictional 18-node graphs, unmodified, with 100 graph-dependent questions: the original 50 plus 50 NEW name-answer questions (one additional question per graph).

metadata.graph_id_mapping: G01-G50 form a separate, newly generated dataset with fresh scenarios and questions
metadata.evaluation_design: Each question has two clues; each clue independently matches exactly two named people, while the conjunction matches exactly one. All answers require graph-specific arbitrary person/artifact associations.
metadata.question_storage: Each graph retains its original `question` for backward compatibility; `questions` contains the original and the added question. Do not count the original question twice.
metadata.additional_question_validation: New correct person differs from original, all four distractors/names occur in the graph, both clues independently match two named people, intersection matches exactly one, all supporting triples exist.
